sections.heading: Verification codes rejected after a phone change
sections.text: Authenticator codes are tied to the device that was enrolled. After a phone change, codes from the new device are rejected until the user is re-enrolled. Re-enrollment requires identity verification by authorized staff.

steps.text: Ask the user to confirm the phone's date and time are set automatically, because clock drift causes code rejection.
Record when the phone was changed and whether the old phone is still available.
Verify the user's identity using the approved identity verification procedure before any re-enrollment.

information_needed.prompt: The date and time of the failed attempt.

stop_conditions.text: If the user asks to turn off two-step verification for their account, stop; support cannot turn it off.
